name: mg_b034_pw_pack_hi_bits_4_3
summary: Packs bit 7 of src_a and bit 7 of src_b into bits 4 and 3 of password buffer slot 0xA8+pw_slot.

name: mg_b034_pw_pack_upper_bits
summary: Packs bits 6..5 of src_a and bits 7..5 of src_b into password buffer slot 0xA8+pw_slot.

name: mg_b034_pw_pack_low5_bits
summary: Stores the lower 5 bits of value into password buffer slot 0xA8+pw_slot.

name: mg_b034_pw_draw_encoded_group
summary: Renders one 5-character encoded password group directly to PPU_DATA using character mapping table 0xBDC0.

name: mg_b034_ppu_draw_bordered_box
summary: Draws a framed rectangular UI box directly to PPU_DATA using dimensions and coordinates from table 0xBE6B.

name: mg_b034_ppu_set_addr_zp90
summary: Writes the 16-bit PPU nametable address stored in zero-page 0x91 (high) and 0x90 (low) to PPU_ADDR.

name: mg_b034_ppu_draw_border_horiz
summary: Writes a corner tile followed by zero-page 0x92 horizontal border tiles (0x7B) to PPU_DATA.

name: mg_b034_ppu_draw_border_vert
summary: Writes a corner tile followed by zero-page 0x93 vertical border tiles (0x9E) to PPU_DATA.

name: mg_b034_ppu_set_vram_inc_32
summary: Sets the VRAM address increment-by-32 bit in g_ppu_ctrl_shadow and writes it to PPU_CTRL.

name: mg_b034_ppu_set_vram_inc_1
summary: Clears the VRAM address increment-by-32 bit in g_ppu_ctrl_shadow to select +1 mode and writes PPU_CTRL.

name: mg_b034_ppu_box_noop_stub
summary: Empty PPU box-drawing helper stub that returns immediately.

name: mg_b034_bank03_check_room_radio_triggers
summary: Checks g_room_id against event tables in 0xBF00 to initiate codec calls or blink transceiver alert bars in the VRAM queue.

name: mg_b034_ppu_flush_vram_queue_from
summary: Processes queued VRAM transfer packets starting at queue_offset into PPU_ADDR and PPU_DATA until a zero terminator.

name: mg_b034_ppu_flush_vram_queue
summary: Flushes all queued VRAM transfer commands starting from index 0 of 0x0740 to PPU_ADDR and PPU_DATA and resets the queue.

name: mg_b034_spawn_room_actors_from_table
summary: Reads the spawn descriptor for g_room_id from 0x82CA, checks directional bounds, and populates enemy/object slots in 0x0308-0x0368.

name: mg_b034_bank04_check_dir_spawn_bounds
summary: Compares scratch coordinates in zero-page 0x82-0x83 against directional screen bounds indexed by g_player_dir.

name: mg_b034_resolve_room_transition
summary: Evaluates special room warps and transition flags in 0x39 against bank-4 exit tables in 0x8A8E to update g_room_id.

name: mg_b034_lookup_next_room_id
summary: Resolves the next g_room_id from room adjacency tables in 0x8A8E using direction index 0x39, or sets 0xFF for rooms 0x80-0xCF.

name: mg_b034_init_cutscene_player_sprite
summary: Initializes player sprite slot 0 with type 200 at coordinates (0x20, 0xC0) for the bank-4 ascent cutscene.

name: mg_b034_tick_ending_ascent_cutscene
summary: Ticks the 16-bit cutscene timer in 0x98-0x99, animates player sprite 200/201 rising upward, spawns trailing sprites, and resets submode on end.

name: mg_b034_check_special_room_dir_warp
summary: Dispatches directional warp logic via inline_jump_table_dispatch in rooms 0xDF and 0xE1, or clears 0x07C9 otherwise.

name: mg_b034_reset_transceiver_cursor
summary: Resets the transceiver/warp state variable at 0x07C9 to zero.

name: mg_b034_arm_or_reset_transceiver_cursor
summary: Arms 0x07C9 to 0x80 if it currently equals 2, otherwise resets it to zero.

name: mg_b034_tick_transceiver_cursor_warp
summary: Advances 0x07C9 state and decrements g_room_id with SFX 0x3A when bit 7 of 0x07C9 is set.

name: mg_b034_tick_binoculars_room_peek
summary: Draws binoculars reticle sprite 0x3A, resolves directional room peek via 0x8120 on D-pad input, and restores the original room after 64 frames.

name: mg_b034_bank04_dispatch_actor_state
summary: Dispatches a bank-4 actor slot via inline_jump_table_dispatch using its state byte in 0xA8+slot_idx.

name: mg_b034_init_homing_projectile
summary: Sets projectile actor slot_idx sprite ID to 0x9C, initializes its step timer to 8, and advances its state in 0xA8+slot_idx.

name: mg_b034_update_patrol_projectile
summary: Checks proximity to the player and, on odd frames, steps the actor along its scripted path in 0xBCA7 while updating its directional sprite.

name: mg_b034_step_homing_projectile
summary: Decrements projectile lifetime timer and moves its X/Y coordinates and sprite ID using directional velocity table 0xBCA7.

name: mg_b034_set_projectile_dir_sprite
summary: Assigns the directional projectile sprite ID from table 0xBCA7+0x0D to actor slot_idx.

name: mg_b034_check_actor_proximity_trigger
summary: Computes player-to-actor distance and switches actor slot_idx to state 2 with timer 0x10 when within 33 pixels on both axes.

name: mg_b034_calc_player_to_actor_delta
summary: Computes signed quadrant bits in 0xB0+slot_idx and absolute Y/X distances between the player and actor slot_idx.

name: mg_b034_dialog_dispatch_phase
summary: Sets dialog active flag 0x4C to 1 and dispatches the current dialog phase in 0x6B via inline_jump_table_dispatch.

name: mg_b034_dialog_dispatch_speaker
summary: Dispatches dialog window layout or speaker variant in 0x48 via inline_jump_table_dispatch.

name: mg_b034_dialog_advance_phase_and_reset
summary: Increments the dialog phase in 0x6B and resets g_dialog_menu_mode and g_status_bar_step to zero.

name: mg_b034_dialog_draw_box_frame_6step
summary: Queues 6 incremental VRAM packets from 0xBF87 to draw and attribute-mask the standard dialog box before advancing dialog phase.

name: mg_b034_dialog_draw_box_frame_8step
summary: Queues 8 incremental VRAM packets from 0xBF87 to draw and attribute-mask an alternate dialog box before advancing dialog phase.

name: mg_b034_dialog_tick_typewriter_and_prompt
summary: Drives codec/dialog text streaming across PRG banks 0, 1, and 5, blinks continuation sprite 0xC5, and handles button-advance timing.

name: mg_b034_dialog_enter_text_mode
summary: Switches g_dialog_menu_mode to 1 (text streaming) and resets g_status_bar_step to zero.

name: mg_b034_dialog_clear_4_rows
summary: Queues one 20-byte blank dialog row into 0x0740 per frame using g_status_bar_step and enters text mode after 4 rows.

name: mg_b034_dialog_advance_clear_step
summary: Stores end_marker into 0x0758, advances g_status_bar_step, and enters dialog text mode at step 4.

name: mg_b034_dialog_enter_text_mode_if_zero
summary: Transitions g_dialog_menu_mode to 1 and resets g_status_bar_step when the CPU zero flag is set.

name: mg_b034_dialog_clear_6_rows
summary: Queues one 16-byte blank row into 0x0740 per frame using g_status_bar_step and enters dialog text mode at step 6.

name: mg_b034_dialog_dispatch_close
summary: Dispatches dialog closing behavior in 0x48 via inline_jump_table_dispatch.

name: mg_b034_dialog_reset_state_on_close
summary: Resets dialog phase and substate counters on close, playing SFX 0x31 when leaving cutscene substate 10.

name: mg_b034_dialog_restore_bg_and_close
summary: Queues saved background tiles and attributes from 0x042C/0x0700 over 8 steps to erase the dialog window and closes dialog state on step 7.

name: mg_b56_transceiver_state_dispatch
summary: Refreshes the transceiver frequency display on odd frames and dispatches the transceiver substate via the inline jump table.

name: mg_b56_transceiver_clear_and_reply
summary: Clears transceiver dialog rows via 0xB81F and resets dialog mode to 0 with substate 1 once row clearing finishes.

name: mg_b56_transceiver_auto_call_wait
summary: Polls for incoming room calls or button press while waiting, then clears the transceiver dialog box and returns to substate 0.

name: mg_b56_transceiver_match_call
summary: Scans the current room's transceiver call table to match frequency, alert, or story triggers, sets dialog message ID 0x0047, and plays sound 0x86.

name: mg_b56_transceiver_stream_dialog
summary: Streams dialog characters from the active message pointer into the 0x0740 VRAM queue, handles page-wait prompts, and signals dialog completion.

name: mg_b56_transceiver_wait_confirm
summary: Advances the cutscene auto-advance timer when Z is set or blinks the transceiver prompt cursor sprite while polling for A-button confirmation.

name: mg_b56_transceiver_clear_dialog_row
summary: Queues a 24-byte blank row transfer to clear the transceiver dialog window and advances or resets dialog step 0x07E0.

name: mg_b56_transceiver_fill_vram_tail
summary: Initializes VRAM queue length metadata and fills trailing buffer slots 0x0743..0x075A with fill_value before incrementing dialog mode 0x07E0.

name: mg_b56_transceiver_update_freq_hud
summary: Converts the active transceiver frequency byte in 0x0046 to two decimal tile digits and queues them into the 0x0740 VRAM buffer.

name: mg_b56_transceiver_init_screen
summary: Clears entity sprites, uploads the 15-row transceiver frame and vertical border columns to PPU nametable memory, re-enables NMI, and plays ring sound 0x79.

name: mg_b56_transceiver_draw_border_col
summary: Writes 11 vertical border tile bytes (0x9E) directly to PPU_DATA for the transceiver frame and returns 0x9E.

name: mg_b56_ending_sequence_dispatch
summary: Dispatches the active ending cutscene phase indexed by 0x0060 through the inline jump table.

name: mg_b56_ending_init_sequence
summary: Resets ending frame counter 0x0055, advances sequence step 0x0060, triggers audio commands 0x86 and 0x81, and jumps to 0xC313.

name: mg_b56_ending_animate_explosion
summary: Queues 4-frame animated tile bursts into 0x0740 every 4 frames for 48 steps, then triggers sound/screen transition and advances the ending step.

name: mg_b56_ending_open_transceiver
summary: Selects the commander frequency 0x0D, initializes the transceiver screen layout, decrements play substate 0x002C, and optionally plays ring sound 0x79.

name: mg_b56_ending_wait_before_scan
summary: Refreshes the transceiver frequency HUD while waiting 256 frames before resetting dialog state, playing sound 0x86, and advancing the ending step.

name: mg_b56_ending_play_first_call
summary: Streams ending transceiver message 0x9B via the dialog printer and resets counters with sound 0x79 before advancing the ending step.

name: mg_b56_ending_delay_and_clear
summary: Waits 64 frames via 0x0055 before clearing the transceiver dialog box and advancing the ending step when clearing completes.

name: mg_b56_ending_sweep_freq_to_78
summary: Updates the transceiver frequency HUD and increments frequency 0x0046 every 4 frames until reaching 0x4E, then plays sound 0x86 and advances the ending step.

name: mg_b56_ending_play_second_call
summary: Streams ending transceiver message 0x1F via the dialog printer and advances the ending sequence step with sound 0x79 upon completion.

name: mg_b56_ending_start_epilogue_bgm
summary: Resets dialog state counters, triggers audio commands 0x86 and 0x65, and advances the ending sequence step.

name: mg_b56_ending_play_final_call
summary: Streams ending transceiver message 0x0F via the dialog printer and triggers audio command 0x85 before advancing the ending step.

name: mg_b56_ending_fadeout_tick
summary: Throttles the ending palette fadeout to every 8th frame before falling through to upload fade steps and reset to the title screen.

name: mg_b56_ending_fadeout_step
summary: Uploads 16-byte fading palette rows to PPU 0x3F00 across three steps and resets game mode and room state at step 0x1E.

name: mg_b56_elevator_check_room_entry
summary: Checks if the player's horizontal tile matches an elevator shaft in the current room and initializes elevator ride coordinates and mode 8.

name: mg_b56_actor_spawn_alert_icon
summary: Clears HUD refresh and cursor slot, and if actor state 0xC0+actor_slot is unset, plays sound 0x06 and spawns sprite 0xC0 at the actor's coordinates.

name: mg_b56_audio_write_pulse_regs
summary: Writes volume/duty (or mute 0x30 when paused/flagged) and period low/high registers to an APU Pulse channel.

name: mg_b56_audio_write_pulse_active
summary: Unconditionally writes active channel duty/volume shadow and period low/high registers to the target APU Pulse channel.

name: mg_b56_audio_sync_pause_mute
summary: Synchronizes pause state 0x0025 with shadow 0x00EA, backing up and muting APU channels on pause or restoring channel registers on resume.

name: mg_b56_audio_restore_pulse2
summary: Restores APU Pulse 2 sweep (if track 0x81 is active) and hardware registers from channel 1 state when Pulse 2 is active.

name: mg_b56_audio_backup_pause_state
summary: Snapshots active SFX channel state bytes into 0x03F8-0x03FE and sets pause marker 0x03FF to 0x31.

name: mg_b56_audio_ramp_dmc_dac
summary: Softly ramps the APU DMC DAC level up or down toward silence in 0x00EB and clears triangle linear control when ramp finishes.

name: audio_engine_frame_tick
summary: Advances audio frame timers/envelopes and updates all 6 APU sound channels.

name: mg_b56_audio_update_channel
summary: Ticks a single audio channel's attenuation, note duration timer, vibrato, and volume envelope, dispatching sequence parsing when the timer hits zero.

name: mg_b56_audio_step_volume_env
summary: Advances a channel's software volume envelope sequence, handling loop opcodes (0xFE) and end markers (0xFF), and writes the attenuated APU volume.

name: mg_b56_audio_apply_attenuation
summary: Stores volume in 0x03E6, subtracts global attenuation 0x03C2 when fade is active (clamping at 0), and writes the result to APU control.

name: mg_b56_audio_check_note_release
summary: Sets release/slur bits 0x06 in channel flags 0x03AA when the remaining note timer falls below the gate threshold in 0x03B6.

name: mg_b56_audio_step_vibrato
summary: Applies 4-phase triangle-wave software vibrato modulation to Pulse 2 period low using parameters in 0x00F0 and 0x03A6-0x03A9.

name: mg_b56_audio_dispatch_seq_mode
summary: Shifts channel_flags bit 0 into carry to branch between SFX sequence parsing (0x9536) and BGM sequence parsing (0x94ED).

name: mg_b56_audio_parse_seq_event
summary: Parses BGM and SFX sequence command opcodes, tempo/duty/sweep updates, and note events for the active audio channel.

name: mg_b56_audio_play_bgm_note
summary: Decodes a BGM note pitch from the frequency table with octave shifting and detune, updates APU period/envelope registers, and advances the channel sequence pointer.

name: mg_b56_audio_advance_seq_ptr
summary: Advances the 16-bit sequence pointer in 0x00D9 by byte_offset + 1 and stores it back into channel pointer tables 0x0398/0x039E.

name: mg_b56_audio_exec_control_opcode
summary: Executes sequence flow-control opcodes including loop-count repeats (0xFE), pattern subroutine calls/returns, and channel stop handlers.

name: mg_b56_audio_setup_note_timing
summary: Computes note duration from base tempo and sequence nibble, handles Noise channel percussion/DMC triggers, and computes gate duration for pitched channels.

name: mg_b56_audio_trigger_sfx_slot1
summary: Triggers sound/noise effect ID 1 via 0x99BB.

name: mg_b56_audio_trigger_sfx_slot2
summary: Triggers sound/noise effect ID 2 via 0x99BB.

name: mg_b56_audio_calc_gate_duration
summary: Multiplies the channel's note duration 0x0380 by the lower nibble of gate_nibble and divides by 16 to compute the note gate cutoff.

name: mg_b56_audio_load_seq_ptr
summary: Loads the 16-bit sequence pointer for channel_idx from 0x0398/0x039E into zero-page 0x00D9.

name: mg_b56_audio_read_branch_ptr
summary: Reads a 16-bit jump target from the active sequence stream at seq_offset + 1 and stores it in 0x0398/0x039E.

name: mg_b56_audio_check_sfx_override
summary: Preserves reg_value while checking whether an active SFX channel overrides BGM Pulse 1/2 (setting carry if muted) and restores APU register offset.

name: mg_b56_audio_reset_apu_channels
summary: Toggles triangle channel off and back on via APU_STATUS and zeroes APU_TRI_LINEAR, returning 0x0F.

name: mg_b56_audio_apu_write_delay
summary: Executes a 10-NOP timing delay subroutine between consecutive APU hardware register writes.

name: mg_b56_audio_write_apu_ctrl
summary: ORs ctrl_value with the channel duty mask and writes it to the APU control register if not overridden by an active SFX channel.

name: mg_b56_audio_silence_all_channels
summary: Clears all 6 channel track IDs, global attenuation, and pause state, resets APU channels, and silences Pulse 1/2 and Noise with sweeps disabled.

name: audio_trigger_sound_or_bgm
summary: Triggers a BGM track or sound effect by ID, handles silence/fade commands, and initializes channel sequence state.

name: mg_b56_audio_init_track_channels
summary: Enables global audio fade on 0x85 or initializes each channel descriptor from the sound table for sound_id subject to SFX priority.

name: mg_b56_audio_trigger_dmc_sample
summary: Configures APU DMC control, address, and length registers from table 0xFC80 for sample_id and restarts the DMC channel.

name: vec_reset
summary: Hardware reset vector that waits for PPU warmup, clears RAM, initializes PPU/APU, switches to bank 6, and starts audio.

name: vec_nmi_handler
summary: NMI interrupt handler that runs OAM DMA, updates PPU mask and scroll, polls joypads, ticks audio, and dispatches the main state.

name: vec_irq_noop
summary: Empty IRQ vector stub that returns immediately.

name: ppu_init_hardware_and_nmi
summary: Initializes APU channels, disables frame IRQ, enables NMI in PPU_CTRL, and sets the 5-frame blanking delay.

name: ppu_enable_nmi_and_delay
summary: Enables NMI and pattern table bits in PPU_CTRL and sets the 5-frame display delay counter.

name: ppu_apply_scroll_and_ctrl
summary: Resets PPU address latch to nametable 0, writes shadow scroll coordinates to PPU_SCROLL, and restores PPU_CTRL.

name: ppu_disable_rendering_and_nmi
summary: Zeroes PPU_ADDR, PPU_MASK, and PPU_CTRL to safely disable rendering and NMI.

name: main_game_state_tick
summary: Increments the global frame counter, checks pause triggers in active states, and dispatches the top-level game state.

name: mg_fxa_call_bank3_b999
summary: Switches to UNROM bank 3, invokes routine 0xB999, and restores bank 6.

name: mg_fxb_enter_attract_demo_mode
summary: Cycles the attract-mode demo sequence index, enables demo mode, enters the transition screen, and advances to the next game mode.

name: enter_transceiver_or_pause_screen
summary: Disables rendering, loads screen layout 0x82 via the bank loader, re-enables display, and invokes the overlay UI setup.

name: mg_fxa_update_title_cursor_sprite
summary: Updates the title screen cursor sprite position from option 0x1E, ticks the state timer, and advances game mode if X is zero.

name: mg_fxb_update_attract_demo_mode
summary: Ticks attract-mode demo state and resets game mode to 0 if the title exit flag is set.

name: mg_fxa_reset_to_game_mode_0
summary: Transitions the game state machine back to top-level mode 0 by calling 0xC43D.

name: game_over_and_continue_handler
summary: Handles game-over music trigger, death timer countdown, and transition to continue or reset state.

name: mg_fxa_dispatch_submode_c1d6
summary: Dispatches the current game submode in 0x11 through the inline jump table at 0xC1D6.

name: mg_fxa_start_new_or_continue_game
summary: Initializes either a new game or a continued game based on menu selection 0x1E and resets the cutscene step.

name: mg_fxa_start_continue_game
summary: Initializes continued game state via 0xD758 and resets the cutscene step counter.

name: mg_fxa_start_room_bgm_and_mode
summary: Updates the room background music via 0xC546 and advances to the next top-level game mode.

name: mg_fxb_tick_demo_and_pause
summary: Polls pause toggle and, while unpaused, counts down the demo state timer to update music and runs the active frame handler.

name: mg_fxa_dispatch_submode_c20d
summary: Dispatches the current game submode in 0x11 through the inline jump table at 0xC20D.

name: mg_fxa_load_screen_and_next_submode
summary: Streams the screen layout at 0xD3CF, clears the CHR stream page index, and advances the game submode.

name: mg_fxb_load_gameover_or_next_chr
summary: Clears PPU mask shadow via 0xC49B and either loads a CHR page and advances submode or loads room 0xF5 layout.

name: mg_fxb_start_room_alert_hud
summary: Queues the room CHR stream and stream 6, clears the entity buffer, advances submode, and queues alert overlay streams.

name: mg_fxa_play_menu_input_sfx
summary: Plays menu confirm or select sound effects via audio trigger when A or Select buttons are newly pressed.

name: mg_fxb_queue_alert_overlay_streams
summary: Queues two XOR-selected PPU tile streams driven by alert channel flags at 0x98.

name: mg_fxb_setup_radio_screen_banks
summary: Queues PPU tile stream 0x14, invokes bank 5 and bank 3 screen setup routines, restores bank 6, and advances game submode.

name: mg_fxb_check_reset_on_a_button
summary: Checks if the A button was newly pressed on joypad 1 and resets the main game state to mode 0.

name: mg_fxa_dispatch_submode_c2bd
summary: Dispatches the current game submode in 0x11 through the inline jump table at 0xC2BD.

name: mg_fxb_tick_demo_or_intro_substate
summary: Switches to bank 4 to run screen state update, then queues stream 9, initializes PPU/HUD state, and sets game mode 4 when submode hits 0.

name: mg_fxb_init_ending_or_special_screen
summary: Disables rendering, uploads room 0xF0 layout and bank 0 screen data, sets palette/stream 0x12, and clears the entity buffer.

name: mg_fxb_init_room_entities_and_boss
summary: Initializes room boss state, collectible/objective objects, scripted room spawns, and room hazard actors.

name: mg_fxa_dispatch_submode_c348
summary: Dispatches the current game submode in 0x11 through the inline jump table at 0xC348.

name: mg_fxb_enter_room_setup
summary: Resets player/world timers on full transition or updates boss, hazard, objective, and pickup spawns on partial room transitions.

name: mg_fxa_resume_gameplay_mode
summary: Restores active gameplay mode 5, clears temporary weapon and room reload flags, resumes room music, and triggers bank 0 alert setup if active.

name: mg_fxa_set_timer_and_next_submode
summary: Sets the low state timer byte in 0x2A and increments the game submode counter by one.

name: mg_fxa_advance_game_submode
summary: Increments the global game submode counter in 0x11 by one.

name: mg_fxa_next_game_mode_with_timer
summary: Advances to the next top-level game mode, sets the state timer to 0x80, and clears the title exit flag and submode.

name: mg_fxa_advance_game_mode
summary: Advances to the next top-level game mode and resets the title exit flag and submode counter.

name: mg_fxa_enter_game_mode
summary: Transitions to the specified top-level game mode with a 0x50-frame timer, resets submode and title exit flags, and returns zero.

name: mg_fxa_tick_state_timer
summary: Decrements the 16-bit state countdown timer in 0x2A-0x2B and returns nonzero while active or on low-byte wrap.

name: mg_fxa_reset_cutscene_advance_submode
summary: Resets the cutscene step counter in 0x07CE to zero and advances the game submode.

name: mg_fxa_dispatch_cutscene_step
summary: Dispatches the active cutscene step in 0x07CE via inline jump table, or advances submode when the step wraps from 0xFF.

name: mg_fxb_begin_cutscene_chr_load
summary: Disables rendering via PPU mask shadow, resets CHR stream page index, queues the room CHR stream, and advances cutscene step.

name: mg_fxb_cutscene_chr_or_room_load
summary: Disables rendering via 0xC49B and either sets the CHR page and advances cutscene step or loads the room nametable layout.

name: mg_fxa_blank_ppu_mask_shadow
summary: Clears the PPU mask shadow register in 0xFE to blank rendering on the next NMI.

name: mg_fxb_step_cutscene_chr_or_room
summary: Clears PPU mask shadow via 0xC49B and either sets CHR page and increments cutscene step or loads room-specific bank graphics.

name: mg_fxb_cutscene_chr_or_tileset_load
summary: Disables rendering via 0xC49B and either records the CHR page and advances cutscene step or uploads the room tileset chunked.

name: mg_fxb_cutscene_decompress_room
summary: Disables rendering, resets vertical PPU scroll to 0xF8, decompresses the current room layout, restores bank 6, and advances cutscene step.

name: mg_fxb_advance_cutscene_palette
summary: Disables rendering via PPU mask shadow, triggers the cutscene palette/fade step from 0x07CE - 5, and increments cutscene step.

name: mg_fxa_cutscene_upload_attr_step
summary: Blanks the PPU mask shadow, uploads the RAM 0x0700 attribute row via 0xC653, and advances the cutscene step.

name: mg_fxb_finish_room_transition
summary: Queues tile stream 5, resets actor and room tables via bank 4 on normal transitions, clears alert sound, enables display, and ends cutscene.

name: mg_fxa_update_room_bgm
summary: Selects and triggers room, alert, or transition background music based on transition state, demo flags, and active alert status.

name: mg_fxa_select_default_area_bgm
summary: Selects default area BGM track 0x69 or 0x45 from room metadata flags and triggers playback when the track changes.

name: mg_fxa_play_bgm_if_changed
summary: Updates the requested BGM track shadow in 0xEF and triggers audio playback when the track changes and demo rules permit.

name: mg_fxa_ppu_upload_menu_text_block
summary: Uploads a null-terminated PPU text or attribute block indexed by entry_index from table 0xC5FF, or runs default layout 0xD3C0.

name: mg_fxa_ppu_upload_status_attr_row
summary: Uploads null-terminated attribute data from RAM 0x0700 to PPU nametable attribute memory at 0x23C0 and re-enables NMI.

name: clear_entity_state_buffer
summary: Zeroes the 128-byte entity state buffer at RAM 0x0300-0x037F.

name: mg_fxa_clear_zp_actor_tables
summary: Zeroes 66 bytes of zero-page actor and alert state starting at address 0x0098.

name: mul_u8_u16_shift_add
summary: Performs a 16-step shift-and-add multiplication storing the result across zero-page 0x80-0x82.

name: inline_jump_table_dispatch
summary: Reads a 16-bit target address from the inline pointer table after the JSR return address and jumps to it.

name: add_u8_to_zp_u16
summary: Adds an 8-bit unsigned value to a 16-bit little-endian integer in zero page with carry propagation.

name: mg_fxa_sub_u8_from_zp_u16

name: mg_fxb_load_room_layout_immediate
summary: Loads the current room's bank and data pointer, immediately streams the nametable data to PPU_DATA, and restores PRG bank 6.

name: load_room_bank_and_pointer
summary: Switches to the PRG bank for the current room and loads its room data pointer into zero-page 0x80.

name: mg_fxa_load_special_room_chr_slice
summary: Selects UNROM bank 0 to upload a chunked nametable slice for special rooms, or marks 0x07CF as 0xFF for standard rooms.

name: mg_fxb_upload_room_tileset_chunked
summary: Selects the room tileset bank and pointer, uploads a chunked nametable slice to PPU_DATA, and restores bank 6.

name: mg_fxb_upload_room_tileset_immediate
summary: Selects the room tileset bank and pointer, streams all tileset bytes immediately to PPU_DATA, and restores bank 6.

name: select_room_tileset_bank
summary: Switches to the tileset PRG bank for the current room and returns the doubled tileset table offset.

name: load_zp80_ptr_from_bank_table
summary: Loads a 16-bit pointer from the active bank's 0x8001 pointer table into zero-page 0x80.

name: mg_fxb_draw_metasprite_to_oam
summary: Decodes a metasprite descriptor from zero-page 0x88 into OAM shadow sprite entries using single-sprite or 2-column layout rules.

name: mg_fxa_emit_metasprite_to_oam
summary: Renders a multi-tile metasprite sequence into the 0x0200 OAM shadow buffer and updates the OAM write cursor in 0x84.

name: mg_fxa_write_oam_sprite_attr
summary: Computes palette and flip attributes from metasprite data at 0x88 and writes the attribute byte to the OAM shadow buffer.

name: mg_fxb_emit_grid_metasprite
summary: Populates a rectangular grid of OAM shadow sprite entries from a metasprite descriptor pointer and advances the OAM write cursor.

name: mg_fxa_finish_oam_sprite_entry
summary: Finalizes a single OAM sprite entry's attributes via 0xCB33, advances the OAM cursor by four bytes, and returns 0x8E.

name: build_oam_sprite_list
summary: Iterates over 32 sprite slots in 0x0300-0x0360 and populates the OAM shadow buffer.

name: mg_fxa_stash_zp_8e_8b
summary: Stores two byte arguments into zero-page scratch locations 0x8E and 0x8B and returns the first value.

name: mg_fxb_init_gameplay_hud_and_audio
summary: Silences audio channels, clears the 0x0300 entity buffer, initializes gameplay PPU/HUD streams, and invokes bank 1 initialization.

name: mg_fxa_ppu_stream_default_layout
summary: Streams the built-in compressed PPU tile layout at 0xD444+0x32 to PPU_DATA and re-enables NMI.

name: mg_fxa_ppu_stream_screen_reset
summary: Disables rendering, resets scroll and queue cursor, streams the compressed PPU layout at 0xD444+8, and re-enables NMI.

name: mg_fxa_ppu_stream_indexed_layout
summary: Disables rendering, resets scroll, streams the compressed PPU nametable layout at 0xD444[layout_offset], and re-enables NMI.

name: update_bank3_sprite_graphics
summary: Switches to UNROM bank 3 to run sprite updates and restores the previous PRG bank.

name: queue_ppu_tile_stream
summary: Copies a PPU tile update stream from the bank-0 table into the 0x0740 NMI transfer queue.

name: mg_fxa_vram_queue_push_byte
summary: Appends a single byte to the 0x0740 NMI VRAM transfer queue and increments the queue cursor.

name: mg_fxa_vram_queue_write_at
summary: Writes a byte to a specific index in the 0x0740 VRAM transfer queue and sets the cursor to the following slot.

name: ppu_upload_zp80_stream_immediate
summary: Disables rendering, streams nametable/attribute bytes from zero-page 0x80 to PPU_DATA until zero terminator, and re-enables NMI.

name: mg_fxb_ppu_upload_inline_stream
summary: Disables rendering, streams inline PPU address and data bytes from after the return address to PPU_DATA until zero terminator, and re-enables NMI.

name: mg_fxb_upload_inline_ppu_wrapper
summary: Forwards directly to the inline PPU data stream uploader at 0xD545.

name: ppu_upload_chunked_nametable_slice
summary: Disables rendering and uploads a 96-byte nametable slice to PPU_DATA while preserving multi-frame cursor state.

name: mg_fxb_tick_demo_mode_state
summary: Polls attract-mode demo inputs and jumps to the current game submode handler via the inline jump table.

name: mg_fxb_start_attract_demo_sequence
summary: Clears RAM, initializes HUD and timers, sets starting player coordinates and room from the active demo table, and advances submode.

name: mg_fxb_setup_demo_room_entities
summary: Initializes room entities and boss state for the attract-mode demo and increments game submode.

name: mg_fxb_tick_paused_or_active_frame
summary: Checks pause button toggle and invokes the main frame update routine at 0xD7CE.

name: mg_fxb_tick_attract_demo_input
summary: Checks Start/Select abort during attract-mode demo and replays timed joypad inputs from the active demo sequence script.

name: mg_fxa_apply_demo_joypad_input
summary: Loads scripted demo input for player 1 from zero-page pointer 0x80 and clears player 2 joypad state.

name: mg_fxb_toggle_gameplay_pause
summary: Toggles the pause flag when Start is pressed during unfrozen non-demo gameplay and plays the pause sound effect.

name: mg_fxa_init_new_game_state
summary: Initializes rank, health, starting room, and player coordinates for a new game and clears gameplay zero-page work bytes.

name: mg_fxa_init_continue_game_state
summary: Initializes player health, spawn room, and coordinates for a continued game while preserving current rank and card flags.

name: mg_fxa_dispatch_room_init_mode
summary: Dispatches the room initialization mode in 0x2C through the inline jump table at 0xD7CE.

name: gameplay_frame_tick
summary: Main active gameplay tick handling pause triggers, radio/transceiver mode, and all entity/world updates.

name: mg_fxb_run_gameplay_simulation_tick
summary: Executes one full gameplay simulation step covering attacks, projectiles, damage, guard vision, actors, bosses, objectives, pickups, health bar, and room gimmicks.

name: mg_fxb_tick_demo_gameplay_frame
summary: Steps periodic player movement in bank 6 for attract-mode demo and runs one gameplay simulation tick.

name: mg_fxb_run_cutscene_and_restore_bank6
summary: Dispatches the cutscene/ending handler and restores PRG bank 6.

name: mg_fxa_call_bank4_bcb8
summary: Switches to UNROM bank 4, invokes routine 0xBCB8, and restores bank 6.

name: mg_fxb_load_transceiver_or_bank3_gfx
summary: Invokes bank 5 transceiver setup when CHR page is 0xFF, or uploads bank 3 tile data from 0x910A otherwise.

name: mg_fxb_update_transceiver_or_exit
summary: Runs bank 5 transceiver UI updates while active, or clears overlay state, uploads PPU return stream, and switches to mode 8 on Select.

name: mg_fxa_queue_hud_and_bank2_digits
summary: Updates HUD health and rank tiles, switches to UNROM bank 2, and formats a 4-digit readout into the 0x0740 VRAM queue.

name: mg_fxa_trampoline_bank3_d8eb
summary: Selects UNROM bank 3 via 0xC93E and transfers control into the swapped bank.

name: mg_fxa_call_bank0_b3fc
summary: Switches to UNROM bank 0, invokes routine 0xB3FC, and restores bank 6.

name: mg_fxb_tick_gameplay_and_score_hud
summary: Runs one gameplay simulation tick, switches to bank 2, converts a counter to 4 BCD digits, and queues the HUD digit VRAM update.

name: mg_fxa_call_bank5_be6a
summary: Switches to UNROM bank 5, invokes routine 0xBE6A, and restores bank 6.

name: mg_fxb_inc_zp80_ptr
summary: Increments the 16-bit pointer stored in zero-page 0x80 by 1.

name: mg_fxb_dec_zp88_ptr_nonzero
summary: Decrements the 16-bit counter at zero-page 0x88 by 1 and returns the bitwise OR of its bytes.

name: mg_fxb_decompress_room_layout
summary: Decompresses the current room's 8x6 metatile grid from bank 5/4 into 0x0400-0x06FF and populates the 48-byte room attribute table at 0x0700.

name: mg_fxb_expand_room_metatile
summary: Expands a 4x4 room metatile from PRG bank 4 into the room layout buffer at zero-page 0x88.

name: mg_fxa_copy_4bytes_to_zp88
summary: Copies four bytes from the source pointer at 0x82 into the destination pointer at 0x88 starting at the given offset.

name: mg_fxa_load_room_data_ptr
summary: Loads the 16-bit room data pointer for the current room ID from the active bank's pointer table into zero-page 0x80.

name: mg_fxb_check_actor_dir_collision
summary: Maps a direction index through the actor collision table, switches to bank 6, and tests background tile solidity.

name: mg_fxb_step_projectile_from_bank6
summary: Switches to PRG bank 6 to run projectile collision/movement at 0xF1ED for a slot and restores bank 0.

name: mg_fxb_backup_and_clear_actors
summary: Copies the four primary actor sprite slots to backup slots, clears active actor states and alert flag, and invokes bank 0 alert cleanup.

name: mg_fxb_update_all_actors
summary: Ticks the global alert timer and iterates over all 8 actor slots to spawn reinforcements or dispatch each active actor's AI behavior.

name: mg_fxb_dispatch_actor_slot_behavior
summary: Routes an actor slot to its type-specific AI handler via the inline jump table or invokes enemy firing when actor type is 0xF0.

name: mg_fxb_dispatch_bank3_actor_state
summary: Switches to PRG bank 3 to invoke the actor behavior dispatcher and restores the previously active PRG bank.

name: mg_fxb_dispatch_bank4_actor_state
summary: Switches to PRG bank 4 to invoke the actor behavior dispatcher and restores the previously active PRG bank.

name: mg_fxa_check_special_room_tile
summary: Checks whether the current room ID and sampled tile ID in 0x8F match the special lookup tables at 0xE630.

name: mg_fxb_pathfind_actor_to_player
summary: Evaluates squared distances and tile/room collision across four cardinal directions for an actor slot and dispatches movement toward the best direction.

name: mg_fxb_calc_actor_dist_sq
summary: Computes the 16-bit squared distance from an actor's stepped position in a candidate direction to the player in zero-page 0x80-0x82.

name: mg_fxa_actor_ai_noop_stub
summary: No-op actor handler stub that returns immediately.

name: mg_fxb_update_actor_ai_state
summary: Updates an actor's alert transition, hit-reaction sprite animation, path sync flag, and dispatches by AI substate at 0xA8+slot.

name: mg_fxa_return_noop
summary: Single-instruction return stub that performs no operation.

name: mg_fxa_step_actor_patrol_script
summary: Advances an actor's patrol script command and timer from bank table 0x8048, entering a wait state or returning actor status.

name: mg_fxb_step_actor_patrol_script
summary: Executes an actor's patrol script bytecode on even frames, updating direction, animation frame, pause/alert opcodes, or firing enemy shots.

name: mg_fxa_update_actor_walk_sprite
summary: Selects and stores the animated walking sprite ID for an actor based on direction, frame counter, and actor type.

name: mg_fxa_grant_actor_health_drop
summary: Applies a health pickup value from table 0xDE2B, sets room init mode to 3, and returns the actor to state 1.

name: mg_fxa_enter_actor_alert_spin
summary: Transitions an actor into state 6 and resets its alert event flag, animation index, and step timer.

name: mg_fxa_tick_actor_alert_anim
summary: Animates an actor's alert or exclamation overlay sprites until its countdown expires, then restores state 1.

name: mg_fxb_dispatch_actor_dir_step
summary: Dispatches an actor movement step by direction bits via the inline jump table, or sets room init mode 8 in room 0xC7 when negative.

name: mg_fxa_move_actor_down_clamped
summary: Increments an actor's Y coordinate in 0x0348 up to the lower screen limit of 0xF1.

name: mg_fxa_move_actor_up_clamped
summary: Decrements an actor's Y coordinate in 0x0348 if it is greater than zero.

name: mg_fxa_move_actor_right_clamped
summary: Increments an actor's X coordinate in 0x0328 up to the right screen limit of 0xA8.

name: mg_fxa_move_actor_left_clamped
summary: Decrements an actor's X coordinate in 0x0328 if it is greater than zero.

name: mg_fxa_start_actor_pause_state
summary: Transitions an actor to pause state 2 and sets a randomized look counter and duration timer from the frame counter.

name: mg_fxa_tick_actor_pause_look
summary: Ticks an actor's pause-and-look timer, cycles idle facing sprites, and transitions back to state 1 when complete.

name: mg_fxb_start_actor_chase_step
summary: Initializes an actor's patrol script, selects a chase direction toward the player, sets AI substate 4, and triggers alert or footstep SFX.

name: mg_fxa_set_actor_script_from_table
summary: Assigns an actor's script offset in 0xB0 from lookup table 0xDF7A using its sub-index.

name: mg_fxb_update_actor_chase_step
summary: Decrements an actor's step timer and advances movement in its current direction if clear, or transitions to substate 5 when blocked.

name: mg_fxb_choose_actor_chase_dir
summary: Computes Manhattan deltas between the player and an actor slot, stores the longer axis step count, and returns the cardinal chase direction.

name: mg_fxb_start_actor_patrol_wait
summary: Runs actor pathfinding toward the player and sets a bounded wait timer in substate 4.

name: mg_fxb_tick_actor_alert_or_fire
summary: Gates actor firing frequency by frame counter and weapon sprite state before invoking enemy shot firing and projectile stepping.

name: mg_fxb_update_actor_attack_shot
summary: Fires an enemy shot for an actor slot via 0xE07A and steps the corresponding enemy projectile slot if active.

name: mg_fxa_update_actor_projectile
summary: Spawns and advances an aimed actor projectile sprite toward the player's current coordinates.

name: mg_fxb_tick_player_and_world_state
summary: Updates special gas/equipment room checks, bank 3 and bank 0 environment hooks, delayed actor spawns, and RC missile steering or player actions.

name: mg_fxb_update_player_action_and_sprite
summary: Checks screen edge exits, updates shield/weapon auxiliary sprite 1 and player OAM sprite coords, and dispatches player action state 0x3C.

name: mg_fxa_check_room_tile_trigger_sfx
summary: Checks whether the player stands on a special room trigger tile and plays sound effect 0x0E or 0x0D.

name: mg_fxa_step_player_one_pixel
summary: Advances the player's coordinates by one pixel in the current facing direction and increments step counter 0x3C.

name: mg_fxb_update_player_movement
summary: Reads player D-pad input, updates player position and facing direction, handles special room boundaries, and tests front tile collisions.

name: mg_fxb_apply_player_dir_step
summary: Sets player facing direction and sprite tile, checks front collision or door/hazard interactions, and nudges player coordinates on free tiles.

name: mg_fxb_step_player_blocked_push
summary: Runs hazard tile checks and pushes player coordinates 1 pixel in the current facing direction.

name: mg_fxa_probe_entity_tile_collision
summary: Probes two directional bounding points against the room tile map using 0xE55F and returns the resulting collision code.

name: mg_fxb_probe_player_front_tiles
summary: Probes two tile positions ahead of the player based on facing direction and returns the matching collision or interaction code.

name: mg_fxa_sample_room_tile_collision
summary: Samples the room layout tile at the pixel coordinates in zero-page 0x80 and returns its collision classification.

name: mg_fxb_handle_player_hazard_tile
summary: Checks if the player stands on a hazard tile in special rooms, decrements player health periodically with sound, and updates animation state.

name: mg_fxa_apply_sprite_nudge_offset
summary: Stores the threshold in 0x81 and nudges player sprite slot 0 X position by one pixel on active frames.

name: mg_fxa_tick_player_punch_anim
summary: Advances the player punch animation timer, toggles the fist sprite X offset, and updates player sprite state.

name: mg_fxb_check_room_screen_edge_exit
summary: Detects when the player crosses a screen boundary or special exit, adjusts entry coordinates, loads the adjacent room via bank 4, and sets mode 8.

name: mg_fxa_place_overlay_sprite_slot1
summary: Configures sprite slot 1 with tile 0x39 at fixed Y 0x5C and X set to player Y minus 0x10.

name: mg_fxb_update_guard_vision_and_alert
summary: Scans enemy line-of-sight along axes toward the player to trigger alert mode, or ticks down the alert timer and resumes room BGM.

name: mg_fxa_trigger_actor_alert
summary: Activates alert mode for the detecting actor in 0x88, displays the alert marker sprite, and triggers alert BGM.

name: mg_fxb_trigger_guard_alert_spot
summary: Displays the exclamation alert sprite above a spotting guard, triggers alert mode and reinforcement cleanup, and plays alert BGM.

name: mg_fxa_scan_actors_trigger_alert
summary: Scans the first four actor slots for an active enemy when not already alerted and triggers alert mode.

name: mg_fxb_update_player_damage_and_blink
summary: Updates periodic hazard/gas health drain, player post-hit invulnerability blink timer, and actor/hazard collision checks.

name: mg_fxb_check_player_actor_overlap
summary: Tests bounding-box overlap between the player and active actor slots to apply contact damage, alert triggers, or damage SFX.

name: mg_fxb_load_room_door_table_ptr
summary: Switches to PRG bank 1 to load the current room's door and transition pointer into zero-page 0x88, then restores bank 6.

name: mg_fxa_check_player_door_entry
summary: Periodically checks player tile collision and room flags to handle door entry and room transition triggers.

name: mg_fxb_check_player_door_or_wall
summary: Checks special room flags or loads the room door pointer and probes the tile at the player's position before dispatching directional handling.

name: mg_fxb_open_vertical_door
summary: Searches the room door list for a matching vertical door at the player's position, queues VRAM tile clear writes, and opens the door.

name: mg_fxb_clear_init_mode_and_push
summary: Clears room init mode 0x2C and pushes the player 1 pixel in their facing direction after hazard checks.

name: mg_fxa_load_zp8c_8d_from_ptr88
summary: Reads a two-byte pair backwards from the pointer in 0x88 into zero-page scratch registers 0x8C and 0x8D.

name: mg_fxa_advance_door_scan_cursor
summary: Increments door loop index 0x91, decrements remaining count 0x90, and returns the entry offset advanced by 7.

name: mg_fxa_set_door_exit_trigger
summary: Sets room transition state 0x39 using the matched door index with bit 6 set and clears room init mode.

name: mg_fxa_advance_door_pos_by_32
summary: Adds 32 to the 16-bit value in zero-page 0x8C-0x8D with carry propagation.

name: mg_fxa_sub_28_from_zp8d
summary: Subtracts 0x1C (28) from zero-page scratch byte 0x8D.

name: mg_fxa_add_28_to_zp8d
summary: Adds 0x1C (28) to zero-page scratch byte 0x8D.

name: mg_fxb_open_horizontal_door
summary: Searches the room door list for a matching horizontal door at the player's position, queues VRAM tile clear writes, and opens the door.

name: mg_fxb_finalize_door_vram_update
summary: Adjusts the door VRAM destination address, records it in the transfer queue, plays door SFX if triggered, and clears room transition state.

name: mg_fxa_scan_horizontal_doors
summary: Scans horizontal door records in 0x88 against player position and direction and triggers transition if unlocked.

name: mg_fxb_open_elevator_or_gate
summary: Searches the room door list for a matching left/right gate or elevator at the player's position and queues VRAM tile updates.

name: mg_fxb_probe_door_after_step
summary: Advances the player's Y tile probe coordinate by 2 and invokes the door/gate matcher at index 3.

name: mg_fxa_check_door_unlock_state
summary: Verifies whether a matched door record is unlocked by checking room init mode, bit 3 flags, and player action state.

name: mg_fxb_handle_room_door_or_elevator
summary: Matches a player-triggered door or teleport entry against required card/direction, updates coordinates, and transitions via bank 4.

name: mg_fxa_add_stride_5
summary: Computes an offset by adding a stride of 5 bytes for the specified number of iterations.

name: mg_fxb_try_player_attack
summary: Checks room eligibility, player state, and A-button input before finding a free weapon slot and dispatching player attack.

name: mg_fxa_spawn_weapon_slot_7a
summary: Finds a free slot in 0x5D-0x5F to deploy an item from stock 0x7A, decrements stock, and plays sound 0x26.

name: mg_fxa_deploy_item_7b
summary: Activates slot 0x52 using item stock 0x7B when available, updates inventory flag bit 2, and plays sound 0x26.

name: mg_fxa_fire_equipped_weapon_sfx
summary: Checks weapon cooldowns and ammo counters in 0x7C and 0x7F and plays the corresponding firing sound effect.

name: mg_fxb_try_place_landmine
summary: Allocates an available mine slot if the player has mines remaining, decrements inventory, spawns the mine, and plays placement SFX.

name: mg_fxa_fire_bullet_with_silencer_sfx
summary: Fires a player projectile every 8 frames when button A is held and plays either silenced or standard gunshot audio.

name: mg_fxa_play_weapon_or_empty_sfx
summary: Plays sound effect 0x11 when flag 0x79 is nonzero or sound effect 0x24 otherwise.

name: mg_fxb_spawn_player_projectile
summary: Finds a free player weapon slot, computes directional spawn coordinates and sprite ID, plays gunshot SFX if unsuppressed, and stores projectile direction.

name: mg_fxb_update_player_weapons_and_bombs
summary: Ticks active enemy projectiles, explosive fuse timers, mine detonation checks, and active player weapon slots 2-7.

name: mg_fxa_step_projectile_movement
summary: Advances the active projectile sprite by direction and speed, despawning it when it leaves screen bounds.

name: mg_fxa_despawn_current_projectile
summary: Deactivates the projectile indexed by zero-page 0x85 and clears its status nibble in 0x4E or 0x61.

name: mg_fxa_despawn_projectile_slot
summary: Deactivates the specified projectile slot, resets associated player weapon flags, and clears its status nibble.

name: mg_fxb_step_active_projectile
summary: Advances a player or enemy projectile, checks screen bounds and tile solidity, tests actor/player hitboxes, and applies damage.

name: mg_fxb_check_projectile_collision
summary: Tests projectile tile solidity and checks hitbox overlap against the player or actors, applying damage on impact.

name: mg_fxb_check_explosive_actor_hits
summary: Checks an explosive or boss-targeting weapon slot against actor slots 8-15, destroys hit targets or damages bosses, and updates room clear state.

name: mg_fxb_check_projectile_hit_slot
summary: Tests whether a projectile sprite overlaps a target actor or player hitbox and deactivates the projectile on impact.

name: mg_fxb_update_enemy_projectiles
summary: Iterates over enemy projectile slots 0x10-0x15 during active boss fights and steps each active projectile using its packed direction nibble.

name: mg_fxa_queue_hud_health_and_rank
summary: Builds and queues PPU tile updates in 0x0740 for the HUD health gauge and player rank indicator.

name: mg_fxb_init_room_boss_encounter
summary: Initializes boss encounter state, health, and sprite coordinates for boss rooms, or selects bank 2 for room 0x76.

name: mg_fxb_update_boss_encounter
summary: Checks if the current room has an active boss, applies pending weapon hits, and dispatches boss AI in PRG bank 2.

name: mg_fxa_is_room_item_uncollected
summary: Checks whether the current room is in the 10-entry item table and returns 1 if its collection bit is still clear.

name: mg_fxb_apply_boss_damage
summary: Decrements boss hit count and HP using the weapon damage table and triggers boss defeat handling and explosion SFX on zero HP.

name: mg_fxa_store_weapon_or_aux_state
summary: Stores the given state value into 0x55 when scratch flag 0x87 equals 3, or into 0x44 otherwise.

name: mg_fxb_init_room_hazards_bank0
summary: Switches to PRG bank 0 to initialize room hazard actors and restores bank 6.

name: mg_fxa_spawn_room_boss_or_prop
summary: Initializes boss or multi-sprite room props in OAM shadow tables 0x0308-0x035F when entering matching special rooms.

name: mg_fxb_dispatch_room_gimmick_tick
summary: Switches to PRG bank 0 and dispatches room-specific gimmick updates such as traps or special hazards based on room ID.

name: mg_fxa_check_room_hostage_flag
summary: Looks up the current room in the 24-entry hostage table and clears 0x65 if that room's rescue bit is already set.

name: mg_fxb_update_prisoners_and_objectives
summary: Animates prisoner sprites, updates rescued-prisoner and destroyed-target bitfields, and triggers radio messages or rank progress.

name: mg_fxa_count_hostages_and_check_rank
summary: Counts rescued hostages across 0x72-0x74 into 0x97 and triggers rank-up audio when rescue thresholds are met.

name: mg_fxa_spawn_room_item_sprites
summary: Populates item and key pickup sprites from bank table 0x884E according to the current room and progression flags.

name: mg_fxb_check_item_pickup
summary: Detects player overlap with room pickup sprites and grants equipment, ammo, rations, cards, or triggers pickup messages and SFX.

name: mg_fxa_collect_supply_item
summary: Applies a collected ration or ammo pickup, updating player health or weapon stock clamped to the current rank maximum.

name: mg_fxb_dispatch_cutscene_or_ending
summary: Selects PRG bank 2 or 0 based on substate 0x6B and jumps through the inline pointer table for cutscene or ending handling.

name: mg_fxb_load_pause_menu_graphics
summary: Uploads bank 3 pause/equipment menu graphics to PPU_DATA and queues stream 0x13 when CHR stream page is 0xFF.

name: switch_bank6_and_play_sound
summary: Switches to UNROM bank 6 and invokes the audio trigger routine for the requested sound ID.

name: mg_fxb_reset_ram_for_demo
summary: Clears gameplay zero-page and RAM buffers and enables NMI via 0xFCC9.

name: mg_fxb_init_new_game_from_title
summary: Clears RAM via 0xFCC9, disables demo mode, and loads the selected title option mode into 0x19.

name: mg_fxb_clear_ram_and_enable_nmi
summary: Disables rendering, zeroes zero-page 0x22-0xEF and RAM pages 0x0300-0x06FF, and re-enables PPU NMI.

name: read_joypads_edge_triggered
summary: Polls both NES joypads, masks held inputs, and records newly pressed button edges in 0xF5 and 0xF6.

name: read_joypads_raw_state
summary: Polls both NES joypads and stores raw held button bitmasks in 0x15 and 0x16.

name: poll_joypad_shift_registers
summary: Strobes hardware joypad ports 0x4016/0x4017 and shifts 8 bits per controller into zero-page 0x84 and 0x85.

name: handle_pause_start_select_trigger
summary: Checks Start/Select edge bits in 0xF5 to toggle pause/transceiver mode or play pause sound effect.

name: mg_fxa_set_timer_256_frames
summary: Sets the 16-bit state timer in 0x2A-0x2B to 0x0100 (256 frames).
